about: 10CL016 LE output comb/reg selects (offline; xdev design oreg:S:V). Each LE drives two local outputs: the direct local line (reaches the LUT inputs in li_direct.json) and the second path. Each has a select bit in the LE's own LUT plane, 1 = combinational, 0 = registered: direct line at frame +9, second path at frame +8 (frame relative to the LE's LUT frame 0). Evidence: swapping which output carries comb/reg (V=0 vs 1) flips exactly these 2 bits, identical at X10Y10 and X22Y8 for all 13 slots measured; with both outputs registered (V=2) both bits are 0 at all 13 slots. (A first reading, +8 = direct line with 1 = registered, fitted V=0/1 but was falsified by V=2.) Value per source slot: [byte offset of the +8 bit, byte offset of the +9 bit] relative to the LE's low LUT byte (no odd-LE flip). Slots 20, 24, 28 not measured (used as destinations). Not tested on silicon.
